description: This file defines the BetaDistribution class, which implements the Beta probability distribution with methods for density, cumulative probability, and statistical properties, extending an abstract distribution class. It includes parameters for shape, methods for computing density, mean, variance, and support bounds, and references to external mathematical libraries.

classes.name: BetaDistribution
classes.description: Implements the Beta distribution with support for density, cumulative probability, mean, variance, and support bounds, extending AbstractRealDistribution.

methods.name: getAlpha
methods.description: Returns the first shape parameter, alpha.

methods.name: getBeta
methods.description: Returns the second shape parameter, beta.

methods.name: recomputeZ
methods.description: Recomputes the normalization constant z based on alpha and beta.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Computes the density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of the density function at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function at a given point.

methods.name: getSolverAbsoluteAccuracy
methods.description: Returns the absolute accuracy for the inverse cumulative probability solver.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support, always 0.

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support, always 1.

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support lower bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the support upper bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates that the support of the distribution is connected (true).
